items.name: Eric N.
items.quote: Before, we were mostly told how to apply things, not why. Now I know why I make each move. Since G3 certification, I handle chassis work orders without waiting for someone to unblock me.

items.name: Anonymous
items.quote: In body repair, multi-layer paint was what sent us backwards. The session put us all on the same method — fewer reworks, fewer nasty surprises.

items.name: Anonymous
items.quote: At the counter, we wasted time finding the right part number. After Parts training, stock and customer requests are clearer for the whole team.
